newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates fluctuated widely before ending higher amid a shortage of funds and are likely to stay at higher levels on Tuesday, dealers said.
"The day started amid uncertainty about the liquidity status," a dealer at KASB & Co said, adding that early overnight trades were seen at 19 percent.

The rates soon fell to 12 percent, but by midday the shortage of funds became evident and the market jumped back to 18.50 percent with trading hours closing with funds changing hands at 19.50 percent, he said.
Dealers said the rates were likely to open at similar levels on Tuesday when the State (central) Bank of Pakistan has called a special open market operation.
